welcome.title: Welcome to {coopName}!
welcome.thanks: Thank you for becoming a shareholder of {coopName}.
welcome.login: You can log in to your dashboard to view your shares and documents.

share-purchase.title: Your order is confirmed
share-purchase.intro: Thank you for your order with {coopName}. We've received it — there's nothing more to do on our website. Use the details below to transfer the amount via your banking app.
share-purchase.step2: Transfer the amount via your banking app using the details above
share-purchase.step3: You'll get a second email once we've matched your payment (usually within 1–2 business days). Only then are your shares active.
share-purchase.noHaste: No rush — you can still pay whenever it suits you.

payment-confirmed.title: Payment Confirmed
payment-confirmed.received: We have received your payment of €{amount}.
payment-confirmed.active: Your shares are now active. Please find your share certificate attached.
payment-confirmed.thanks: Thank you for being a shareholder of {coopName}!

dividend-statement.title: Dividend Statement {year}
dividend-statement.attached: Please find attached your dividend statement for {year}.
dividend-statement.thanks: Thank you for being a shareholder of {coopName}!

password-reset.title: Password Reset Request
password-reset.requested: You have requested to reset your password.
password-reset.click: Click the link below to reset your password:
password-reset.ignore: If you did not request this, please ignore this email.
password-reset.expires: This link will expire in 1 hour.

magic-link.title: Login to OpenCoop
magic-link.click: Click the button below to log in:
magic-link.expires: This link expires in 15 minutes. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

gift-certificate.title: Your Gift Certificate
gift-certificate.thanks: Thank you for purchasing a gift certificate at {coopName}!
gift-certificate.received: Your payment has been received and the gift certificate is attached to this email.
gift-certificate.share: Share this certificate with the recipient. They can use the code or QR code to claim their shares.
gift-certificate.thanksEnd: Thank you for being a shareholder of {coopName}!

message-notification.title: New message from {coopName}
message-notification.body: You have received a new message from {coopName}.
message-notification.subject: Subject

meeting-convocation.title: Notice — {coopName}
meeting-convocation.subtitle: General Meeting
meeting-convocation.intro: On behalf of {coopName}, you are invited to the {meetingTitle} on {humanDate} at {meetingLocation}.
meeting-convocation.proxy: Click the button above to indicate whether you will attend, will not attend, or to delegate your vote to another shareholder (proxy).
meeting-convocation.attachment: The official notice is attached as a PDF.

meeting-rsvp-confirmation.title: Confirmation — {coopName}
meeting-rsvp-confirmation.subtitle: General Meeting
meeting-rsvp-confirmation.attending: Thank you for confirming. We look forward to your attendance.
meeting-rsvp-confirmation.absent: We have noted that you will not be able to attend.
meeting-rsvp-confirmation.proxy: You have delegated your vote to {delegateName}.
meeting-rsvp-confirmation.attachment: A calendar invite (.ics) is attached — works with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook, and Thunderbird.

meeting-reminder.title: Reminder: General Meeting
meeting-reminder.body: Reminder: the {meetingTitle} is in {days} day(s) on {humanDate}. You haven't yet responded. Please RSVP:
